name: focuscode
description: Keep your focus on the active code block. Supports Python, C++, HTML, Go, React, and more to come.

focus.opacity.description: Opacity of the out-of-focus lines, from 0 to 1 (e.g., 0.5, 0.85).

focus.opacityLight.description: Opacity of out-of-focus lines in light themes. Leave empty to use focus.opacity.

focus.opacityDark.description: Opacity of out-of-focus lines in dark themes. Leave empty to use focus.opacity.

focus.fadeDuration.description: Fade time in milliseconds (best effort, 0 disables).

focus.showStatusBar.description: Show the FocusCode toggle in the status bar.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Highlight the active code block (Works for Python, HTML, C++, etc.)

focus.highlightLines.markdownDescription: This configuration is only useful when `#focus.highlightRange#` is set to *fixed*. This means how many lines will be highlighted.

focus.autoMatchLevel.markdownDescription: Sets which block level to focus on. `1` is the innermost block (e.g., an if statement). `2` is the parent block (e.g., the function containing it).
